digest.component_or_area: IAM policy and instance role configuration for Bedrock API access
propositions: The review-bot container requires Bedrock credentials via the existing instance role but currently lacks any Bedrock IAM permissions, only SSM and KMS access.

An IAM grant must authorize bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream (not bedrock:Converse, which is a distinct action that the simulator cannot validate), scoped to Claude foundation models and anthropic-prefixed inference profiles.
IMDS must be reachable from the review-bot container; if an IMDSv2 token request fails, the hop-limit contingency raises http_put_response_hop_limit to 2 and documents the bounded exposure in an ADR.
The new policy belongs in a separate infra/terraform/iam_s7.tf file following the established iam_s2.tf/iam_s4a.tf convention, never modifying the single-owner iam.tf.

Real runtime verification from the instance is required to confirm the grant works, including a negative control denying non-Claude models, because policy simulation answers a different question than which action the Bedrock service actually authorizes.
